fullContentHtml:
BPSC DSO Marks 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) will release the Marks for the post of District Sports Officer DSO. This recruitment was released for 33 posts. Applications for the BPSC DSO Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 02, 2025, to September 26, 2025. The written examination was conducted on 29-30 January 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their BPSC DSO Marks 2025 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2025
  • Last Date : 26 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 29-30 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 22 January 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 February 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 19 March 2026
  • Marks : 30 July 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
